title: Apartment for sale: Rijswijkstraat 21 1062 EP Amsterdam | Funda
author: funda.nl
summary: We are pleased to offer this spacious and well-laid-out apartment of approximately 80 m² (NEN2580), located in the pleasant Hoofddorpplein neighbourhood. The apartment features a bright living room with an open kitchen and balcony, three bedrooms, a modern bathroom with a walk-in shower, a separate toilet, and a separate laundry room. Thanks to the double glazing throughout, the apartment is light, comfortable, and energy efficient.
